purpose: Resolve the seven C2-LT-B6 local-review issue rows into guideline-route, publisher/manual-review and source-lineage candidates without changing reviewed artifact or model admission status.

nonClaims: This register does not change any source into reviewed evidence.
This register does not create reviewed artifacts, Source Cards, variable cards, endpoint cards, uncertainty cards, transfer-boundary cards or downgrade rows.
This register does not authorize model admission, individual advice, individual death-date output, clinical validity claims or intervention ranking.
This register only prepares guideline-route, publisher/manual-review and source-lineage candidates that must pass manual/fulltext extraction and independent fresh review before bounded artifact use.
